groups.name: MGMT
groups.oct_why: floor spread 0.7700 mm (10.16 deg at 6 GHz) exceeds max_spread_mm 0.5: shortest member P >= 17.2272 mm, longest N >= 17.9972 mm. An octilinear router (KRT moves in 8 directions, so the shortest pad-to-pad copper is max(dx,dy)+0.4142*min(dx,dy)) cannot do better — accepted because `elongation: meander` is declared and route.yaml carries a length_match_group, so the short members are deliberately lengthened. The realized spread below is the check that the elongation actually happened.
